background: Goldman Sachs International Bank is the London-based bank of The Goldman Sachs Group, taking Marcus retail deposits in the UK and corporate deposits, and lending alongside the group's European investment banking business.
synthesis: The bank is rated A+ on average across all three main agencies, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026, and the grades rest on the parent. The site holds only its LCR, at 126%, which is in the bottom quarter of UK mid-sized banks against the peer median, so on the one liquidity measure available it carries less surplus than its peers, though none of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. A deposit here is a claim on a Goldman entity, and the group's strength and the positive outlook from one of the three are the main comfort.
